title: Design System: The Grove Community Collective

brandArchitecture.status: Working decision as of 2026-10-06, pending final client confirmation (PRODUCT.md question 26). Logo PNGs in public/brand/ pending client approval; vector originals still to come.
brandArchitecture.heritage: thegrove.work used near-black, off-white and amber with no green (research/thegrove-work-brand-review.md).

showtime.role: Basketball training program operating at The Grove
contexts: amber date chip on Showtime-run past events (showtime: true)

constraints: Amber must not become the dominant Grove accent unless later brand evidence supports it; the site must not feel like a Showtime Basketball website.
On dark Grove surfaces the accent and rules are off-white; forest would disappear on near-black, and the mint forest-light was removed as off-palette.

display.purpose: Hero names only (THE GROVE., SHOWTIME). Oswald 600 caps, 0.86 leading.

headline.purpose: Page h1s and SectionHeading h2s; 0.92 to 0.98 leading on large stacked headings.

title.purpose: Wrapping list-row titles, event names, panel headings; leading 1.0 or above.

label.purpose: Small tracked caps (.label): footer column heads, form labels, hero meta.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.value: outline: 2px solid var(--paper); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--black)
shadows.purpose: Global two-tone :focus-visible ring; the only shadow in the system.

motion.name: rise-in
motion.purpose: Hero entrance: 18px rise with fade. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: line-draw
motion.purpose: Hero brand rule draws in from the left.

motion.name: hover-color
motion.purpose: Button and link colour transitions; the only non-hero motion.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Split heroes go two-column; desktop nav replaces the mobile menu.

narrative.overview:
The site is The Grove's own house with Showtime Basketball Academy as the program that trains inside it. The system makes that brand architecture visible in colour: Grove surfaces are near-black, off-white and forest green, and amber appears only where Showtime is speaking. It evolves the old thegrove.work look (monochrome, heavy all-caps headlines, the geometric mark) rather than rebranding it.

Pages are editorial and asymmetric. Stacked, condensed, all-caps block headlines sit over a short brand rule, and full-bleed split heroes put text against squared real photography. Lists are ruled rows rather than card grids. Section bands alternate paper, paper-deep, forest and black. The surfaces are flat, the corners are square, and motion is limited to the hero entrance and hover colour shifts.
keyCharacteristics: Two related brands told apart by colour: forest/off-white for The Grove, amber for Showtime.
Oswald 600 condensed caps stacked with tight but non-colliding leading.
A 48px brand rule under every section heading, in the speaking brand's colour.
Squared real photography that bleeds to the viewport edge in split heroes.
One button family with a 2px radius.
Flat tonal banding with no shadows.

rules.name: The Speaking Brand Rule
rules.body: Before using amber, ask "is Showtime speaking here?" If the answer is no, use forest on light surfaces and off-white on dark ones.

rules.name: The Off-White On Dark Rule
rules.body: On near-black and forest, Grove accents, rules and `Accent` lines are paper, never forest and never mint.

rules.name: The Muted Floor Rule
rules.body: Muted text on dark surfaces is paper at 65% opacity or more. Body copy on dark surfaces sits at 70 to 75%.

rules.name: The Leading Floor Rule
rules.body: Only large single-line or deliberately stacked display headings go below 1.0 (0.86 to 0.98). Anything that wraps (subheads, list titles, quotes) stays at 1.0 or above so condensed caps never touch. `.font-display` sits in `@layer components`, so `leading-*` and `tracking-*` utilities do take effect.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: `Accent` produces at most one two-colour headline per page. Its second line is forest on paper, paper on dark Grove surfaces, and amber on black only for Showtime.

rules.name: The Banding Rule
rules.body: Section bands alternate paper, paper-deep, forest and black. A closing band never runs black into the black footer: the closing CTA is forest or paper.

rules.name: The Flat Band Rule
rules.body: Separate content with colour bands and rules, never with shadows or floating cards.

dos: Do use amber only where Showtime is speaking: the /programs hero, Join Showtime buttons, the Showtime rule, the "Showtime standards." accent, and Showtime event date chips.
Do make Grove accents and rules off-white (paper) on near-black and forest surfaces.
Do set large display headings at 0.86 to 0.98 leading and keep anything that wraps at 1.0 or above.
Do follow every section heading with the 48px brand rule, then the body copy.
Do use `ButtonLink` at 44px or 48px with the 2px radius, and pass `external` for off-site links.
Do use squared real photography that bleeds to the viewport edge in split heroes, using `.gutter-start` / `.gutter-end` with minmax(0, …) tracks.
Do alternate paper, paper-deep, forest and black bands, and end pages on forest or paper before the black footer.
Do keep WCAG 2.2 AA: the two-tone focus ring, muted text on dark at paper/65 or more, and gray (#5c5a55) as the lightest small text on paper.
donts: Don't let amber become the dominant Grove accent or make the site feel like a Showtime Basketball website.
Don't use forest-on-black or the removed mint "forest-light".
Don't put kicker or eyebrow labels above headings.
Don't use more than one `Accent` two-colour headline per page.
Don't build card grids with shadows. Use ruled, asymmetric lists.
Don't use Unicode arrows or glyph icons. Use the line icons in `components/Icon.tsx`.
Don't redraw or substitute the Grove mark or lockup, or use illustrations or placeholder SVGs in place of photos.
Don't add `outline-none` or a black closing band directly above the black footer.
